D One Boka Residence

A Private Collection Of Luxury Residences Overlooking The Adriatic Coast.

About Us

More Than a Place.It's a Home.

Located in Dobrota, D One Boka Residence is a thoughtfully designed residential project that combines modern architecture with a carefully considered sense of space, light, and privacy. The development offers a limited number of residences within a quiet, well-positioned setting overlooking the Bay of Kotor.

About the project

Residencies

Designed as Two Unique Buildings

Building 1

A limited collection of only four exclusive residences designed with an emphasis on privacy, spacious interiors, and panoramic views of the Bay of Kotor.

Building 2

A refined residential building offering thoughtfully designed apartments, modern amenities, and a comfortable living experience in Dobrota.

Apartments

Residencies Of Distinction

S1 ground floor, one-bedroom apartment

A spacious one-bedroom residence featuring an open-plan living area and a private terrace, designed for comfortable seaside living.

S2 ground floor, two-bedroom apartment

An elegantly proportioned two-bedroom home with generous natural light, refined finishes, and a calm coastal atmosphere.

S5 second floor, three-bedroom apartment

A rare upper-floor residence offering expansive terraces, uninterrupted sea views, and exceptional privacy.

S7, ground floor, one-bedroom apartment

A thoughtfully designed studio with direct garden access, ideal for a serene retreat close to the waterfront.

S13, first floor, two-bedroom apartment

A generous three-bedroom layout with distinct living zones, ideal for families seeking space and comfort by the coast.

S14, first floor, one-bedroom apartment

A distinctive duplex residence spanning two levels, complete with a private pool and refined indoor-outdoor living.

S15, first floor, one-bedroom apartment

A refined one-bedroom apartment oriented toward the bay, with floor-to-ceiling glazing and a seamless connection to the landscape.

S18, second floor, three-bedroom apartment

A bright corner residence with dual-aspect views, a generous terrace, and a calm, contemporary interior palette.
